maria: Draft ready — pasted latest into the doc https://docs.google.com/xxx (internal). Need quick passes on benchmark language, CTA mapping, and webinar/demo seat allocation. Target publish window: Tue 09:00 PT.

owen: CTA mapping question — do we split CTAs on the blog for devs vs. enterprise? my proposal below:
```
Top of post CTA -> Try hosted API (free credits)
Mid-article CTA -> Join webinar (register)
End CTA -> Request a demo (sales lead form)
```
This keeps the funnel clean.

maria: love that. can we add a small inline note near the mid-article CTA: "Seats limited, priority given to teams with >500 employees" so partners/demo-ops can route appropriately?

jake: good call. I'll update the CTA buttons in the doc + add UTM tags: utm_campaign=apex-launch&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta

olivia-demoops: demo ops will use the UTM to route into the correct queue. also adding note: registrants with "partner_code" get 2nd-tier routing.
